_design: Overlord jab 2 v3 (ANIM-JAB-5, 2026-11-12) from cards/overlord/jab/overlord_jab_v3_pose_plan.md: villain claw slap with a step forward, then he looks at his hand. f0 = jab 1 f12. f3 weight onto the right foot, f6 windup (left knee up, chest 55 right, claw high behind the head), f8 left foot lands heel first, f9 contact in a deep lunge with the arm on a descending diagonal, f13 rake to low-left at the lowest point, f20 observe (forearm vertical in front of the face) held to the FAF f26; tremor f27-37 lives in the Manuale layer; clench f38-41, head up first, right foot steps up to the idle stance f41-47, idle f52 30 cm ahead of the start. r2: the observe/tremor beat is gone from the card (f26-52 settle); the Manuale tremor layer f27-37 still needs a decision.
_changes: v3: new card, nothing reused from v2 (rejected in game as static). r1 (2026-11-14, offline, owner notes round 1): root motion removed (no root_ctrl edits), the 18 cm step is in pose space (left foot +18 f4-f9, pelvis.loc forward over it), right foot planted on the jab 1 stomp spot until f46, recovery: left foot steps back f41-46, right foot shuffles back to idle f46-50, f52 exact idle at the origin (net travel 0). Windup keys f4/f5 added (hand rises and goes back every frame f0-f6), f1 key (42% toward the break), contact hand at chest height on the target's near side, rear leg long, heel up. Backup: overlord_jab2_v3.r0.backup.json. r2 (2026-11-15, offline, review r1): f0 = 50% from the NEW jab 1 hold toward the break, windup re-spaced f0-f6; contact lunge shifted left (pelvis +8/+23.5, chest leans left 10), wrist (-20, 80, 128) outside the own outline from behind; arm lowers f12-f17 in 4-12 cm steps; step back f15-f23 (left f16-19, right f20-23), f26 near idle, f26-52 settle; observe pose removed; every frame 0-26 keyed. Backup: overlord_jab2_v3.r1.backup.json. r3 (2026-11-15): owner's Cascadeur poses are the base (owner_r3/), full arc with follow-through past the owner's last key, built by jab_r3_plans.py + pose_plan.py. v3 r2b card kept as overlord_jab2_v3.r2b.backup.json.
_tremor: Not in the card: the hand tremor f27-37 is keyed on hand_r_fk_ctrl Rotation in the additive 'Manuale' section of LS_OverlordJab2V3_Build (see v2 _tremor), zero at f26 and f38.
_part_delays_why: 0 on purpose: chest_ctrl and lowerarm FK keys place the shoulder and the elbow, so a chest/forearm delay moves the wrist off the f9 contact; a head delay makes the head lag a trunk unwinding ~30 deg/frame and look away at contact (the head counter-turns to stay on the target); the wrist cock/flick is authored per key (7, 8, 9, 11). The chain lag (R3) is written into the dense startup keys instead.
_planted_why: r3: feet go through world targets (foot_w / idle_w) on every key, steps lifted; nothing to snap.
_fists_why: open-hand slaps by design (owner 2026-11-08): no hand has to be a fist
_step: Step in POSE space (r2): no root motion. Left foot: idle f0-2, heel peels f3-4, air f5-7 (knee up f6), heel strike f8 at +17.5 cm, flat f9-15, lifts f16, lands on idle f19. Right foot: jab 1 stomp spot (idle +17 cm) f0-19 (heel up 10 deg f9-14), lifts f20, lands on idle f23. Pelvis.loc y: 14 (f0 = jab 1 hold) -> -4.5 (f6) -> 19 (f8) -> 23.5 (f9-13) -> 5.5 (f19) -> 0.3 (f26) -> 0 (f52).
